Key accounts, channels and new business · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Agreement milestone tracking

Max · Partnerships Coordinator

An education group has 47 business development agreements in force, with milestones (pilot cohort, semester report, automatic renewal, regional exclusivity) scattered across PDFs and in the heads of 4 managers.

When it runs
Every Monday at 7 a.m., reading the agreements folder and the CRM, and immediately when a newly signed agreement is added to the folder or when a milestone enters the 60-day window
What it delivers in production
Every Monday, a list per manager with the milestones for the next 60 days and the evidence found or missing, plus the alert to the director on agreements in their renewal window, with the annual value.
Who decides
Watches and proposes; legal approves
Effort
Rebuild 2025 week by week; 8 weeks
Set up5 steps · 8 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

# Rules for windows, decisions and evidence

## Windows
- Notice deadline: end_of_term minus notice_days, in the contract's day type. Empty day_type: LEGAL QUESTION, with no date calculated, and the watch does not continue with that agreement.
- Automatic renewal with no decision: alert to the BD director when 90 days or fewer remain to the deadline; also to legal, with a draft notice, at 45 days or fewer or with an annual value above R$ 500 thousand.
- Milestone: goes on the list when its date is in the next 60 days (from today to today + 60).

## Recorded decision
- Only an interaction in crm_interactions.csv whose summary starts with "DECISION:" counts. A meeting with no decision does not count.

## Evidence
- MET: a file of type proof in agreements_folder.csv for the milestone. IN PROGRESS: a file of type partial. NOT FOUND: no file.
- A manager's statement in the CRM, with no file, does not count.
- Student lists: cite only the file name and the date, never the content.

## National holidays in the period
2026-11-02, 2026-11-15, 2026-11-20, 2026-12-25 and 2027-01-01.

## Rules with no leeway
- Deadline in calendar days and days left counted from today (2026-11-09). E.g.: A01 ends on 2027-01-31 with 60 days: deadline 2026-12-02, 23 days left; A10: deadline 2027-01-19, 71 days left.
- All the bands apply together. E.g.: A01 (23 days and R$ 1.2 million) goes to the director and to legal with a draft; A10 (71 days, R$ 280 thousand) only to the director; A09 has a DECISION in the CRM and leaves the alert.
- Task due date: 10 days before the milestone, moved back to the previous business day. E.g.: A02 (milestone 2026-11-30) would fall on 2026-11-20, a holiday: due 2026-11-19. A10 (milestone 2026-12-10): due 2026-11-30.
- Alert to the manager and the director only for a milestone with no evidence at 30 days or fewer. E.g.: A02 (21 days) yes; A10 (31 days) task only.
- An agreement with no file of type contract has no milestone checked, even with a proof. E.g.: A08.
- Exclusivity: same state and same segment. E.g.: Rede Oeste Clinic (PR, health) collides with A05; Serra Alta Hospital (RS) and Pinho Laboratory (industry) do not.

## Excluded excerpt
Whatever a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "excerpt excluded by rule", without repeating the content.

## Single pass
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and write the file to Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, draft, write). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI never sends a non-renewal or renegotiation notice to the counterparty: it drafts, legal approves and the BD director signs. An ambiguous renewal clause, in calendar or business days, becomes a LEGAL QUESTION and the watch stops. Milestone evidence is a document in the folder or a record in the CRM; the manager's word that it was delivered does not count until the file exists. Student lists are personal data: the agent checks only that they exist and the date they were sent. The service account reads the agreements folder and writes only to the master table and CRM tasks, in Work Mode Supervised, with Plan approval from legal for the notice.

Common mistakes

  • Counting the notice period from the end of the term when the contract counts it from the signing of the amendment.
  • Recording the main agreement and forgetting the amendment that changed the milestone or the term.
  • Treating a report sent by email as fulfilled when the contract requires filing or formal acceptance by the counterparty.
  • Alerting on all 47 agreements every week; the manager stops reading.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Automatic renewals that happened with no recorded decisionfrom 3 in 2025 to zero, with a mandatory 90-day windowprocess target, not the agent's (estimate based on the described routine)
Contractual milestones met on timefrom not measured to above 95% of milestones with evidence in the folderestimate based on the described routine

MILESTONES IN 60 DAYS | Dual degree partnership University Q | milestone: semester academic report by 09/30 | evidence: NOT FOUND in the folder | contractual consequence: suspension of new enrollments in the program | task proposed in the CRM for R. Melo, due 09/20.
MILESTONES IN 60 DAYS | Content contract Publisher R | milestone: delivery of 12 revised modules by 10/31 | evidence: 8 modules with acceptance minutes on 09/01 | task: confirm the schedule for the remaining 4.
MILESTONES IN 60 DAYS | Exchange agreement Institution S | milestone: send the student list by 10/15 | evidence: email of 09/02 with a preliminary list | status: IN PROGRESS.
EXCLUSIVITY | Partnership with Company T provides regional exclusivity in 2 states until 2027; the CRM records a proposal to a competitor of Company T in one of those states on 08/28. ALERT to the BD director and legal.
SUMMARY: 11 milestones, 3 without evidence, 1 renewal in its window, 1 exclusivity alert. Annual value in a decision window: R$ 1.2 million.
